pipeline.note: Bridge, key check, function calling, usage recording and cost estimate all worked.

usage.price: US$0.30 in / US$2.50 out per 1M (2026-10-17); cached tokens counted at full price, so the bill should not exceed the estimate

onboarding.stepsBeforeDriver: inspect_device, list_interfaces, inspect_device, read_manual, connect (TCP), handshake: all ok in 6 calls
onboarding.failingCheck: 驅動程式拒絕失敗或毀損回覆 (decode must reject malformed/error device replies.)

offlineCheckOfEachVersion.result: From version 2 on, decode threw for not-json and ok:false but accepted both replies with invalid accepted values in every later version; the last, untested version also accepted ok:false again.

comparisonWithHaiku: Same feedback text for both models. Haiku failed this check with its first JSON-protocol driver in every P2 and VLAB-Y run and passed on the second version (VLAB-Y 9/9; LIVE_EXPERIMENTS §4.20). The P2/VLAB-Y driver contract does not say that error replies must throw; the G3 and VLAB-X contracts do.
interpretation: Model failure at the driver gate on the development device, not an adapter defect. Gemini wrote no thinking tokens (model default), while Haiku 5.5 ran with its default adaptive thinking; this difference is an open confound for the author to decide before the held-out runs.
reportingFix: batch-summary showed controllerFirstTry=True although test_controller never ran; run_experiments.py now reports None when a test tool never ran.
notUsedFor: No gate, prompt, manual, reference module or threshold was changed because of this pilot.
